Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner concluded that Richard Beauchamp’s paternal grandfather was Guy de Beauchamp based on a misleading search snippet and did not verify the claim with authoritative sources. In reality, William de Beauchamp (1st Baron Bergavenny) was the son of Thomas de Beauchamp (11th Earl of Warwick), making Thomas—not Guy—the correct paternal grandfather. The error originated when the Planner accepted the snippet’s claim without cross-checking, anchoring subsequent steps to the wrong lineage.
